heroDescription.arquitectura:
Architecture is an expression of lifestyle.

It defines the unique character of the villa, combining aesthetics, space and functionality into a harmonious whole.
heroDescription.acabados:
Finishes are the final touch that defines the level of a home.

Attention to detail, quality of materials and precision in execution create a coherent and comfortable environment.

dataCollected.title: 2. Personal data we process
dataCollected.content:
Through this website we may process the following categories of personal data:

• Identification data: first and last name.
• Contact data: email address and phone number.
• Communication data: content of messages sent via the contact form.
• Technical data: IP address, browsing data and cookies when necessary for security or site operation.

purposes.title: 3. Purposes of processing
purposes.content:
We process your personal data for the following purposes:

• To manage and respond to requests received through the contact form.
• To maintain commercial or informational communications related to our construction, engineering, architecture and investment services.
• To ensure website security and prevent fraudulent or abusive use.
• To comply with applicable legal obligations.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal basis for processing
legalBasis.content:
Processing of your data is based on:

• Your consent when submitting the contact form.
• Pre-contractual measures or management of commercial enquiries.
• Legitimate interest in maintaining website security and preventing spam or fraud.
• Compliance with legal obligations, where applicable.

contactForm.title: 5. Contact form
contactForm.content:
When you use the contact form, we collect the data you voluntarily provide (name, email, phone and message) to handle your enquiry.

Data is securely sent to info@structonixsistem.com via a professional email delivery service. Please do not submit specially protected or confidential information that is not necessary for your request.

The site may use Google reCAPTCHA v3 to protect the form against automated submissions. Use of reCAPTCHA is subject to Google's Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

retention.title: 6. Data retention period
retention.content:
We will retain your personal data for as long as necessary to handle your request and, subsequently, for the periods required by applicable law or until you request deletion, where appropriate.

Communications arising from the contact form will be retained while we maintain a commercial relationship or for a reasonable period to respond to related future enquiries.

recipients.title: 7. Recipients and processors
recipients.content:
Your data may be shared with providers that deliver services necessary for website operation, such as hosting, transactional email (Resend) and security tools (Google reCAPTCHA), always under agreements that ensure confidentiality and compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR).

We do not sell or transfer your personal data to third parties for commercial purposes.

rights.title: 8. Your rights
rights.content:
Under the GDPR, you may exercise the following rights:

• Access: know what data we process about you.
• Rectification: correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
• Erasure: request deletion of your data where applicable.
• Objection and restriction: object to or restrict certain processing.
• Portability: receive your data in a structured format, where applicable.
• Withdraw consent: at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing.

To exercise your rights, email info@structonixsistem.com stating your request and verifying your identity. You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es) if you believe processing does not comply with the law.

cookies.title: 9. Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.content:
This website may use technical cookies necessary for operation and third-party cookies related to security services (reCAPTCHA) or analytics, if implemented in the future.

You can configure your browser to block or delete cookies. Note that some site features may become unavailable if you disable essential cookies.

security.title: 10. Security measures
security.content:
Structonix Sistem Global S.L. applies appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, loss, destruction or alteration.

Among other measures, we use secure connections (HTTPS), form validation, submission rate limiting and antispam verification on the contact form.

changes.title: 11. Changes to this policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect legal changes or improvements to our services. The current version will always be available on this page with the last updated date.

marbella.name: Marbella
marbella.heroTagline: Turnkey luxury villa construction, architecture, engineering and project management for international clients across Marbella, the Golden Mile and Nueva Andalucía.
marbella.overview:
Marbella is the centre of luxury residential construction on the Costa del Sol, attracting buyers and developers from across Europe, the Middle East and the CIS. Structonix delivers contemporary villas, full renovations and ground-up developments here, managing every stage from land due diligence and licensing to handover.

Our team of more than 40 architects, engineers and project managers works as a single integrated unit, which is exactly what international owners need when building remotely. We coordinate municipal permits, technical design and on-site execution so clients keep full visibility without having to live in Spain during the build.
marbella.market: Demand in Marbella is concentrated in the Golden Mile, Nueva Andalucía's Golf Valley, Sierra Blanca and the eastern beachside corridor. Plots are scarce and expensive, so most projects are either premium new builds on the few remaining parcels or complete demolition-and-rebuild schemes. Build quality, energy efficiency and design distinction are the main differentiators in this market, and the LPO (first occupation licence) timeline is a critical factor in any realistic project plan.
marbella.architecture: We design modern Mediterranean and contemporary villas tailored to Marbella's PGOU planning rules, plot orientation and sea views. Our architecture service covers concept design, planning submissions and full technical documentation, always balancing design ambition with what the Marbella town hall will actually approve.
marbella.engineering: Marbella's hillside plots and coastal conditions demand serious structural and MEP engineering. We handle foundations for steep terrain, retaining structures, pools and basements, plus the climate, water and energy systems that a high-end villa requires under Spanish regulations.
marbella.projectManagement: For owners building from abroad, our project management is the core of the service. We act as your single point of contact, controlling budget, schedule, contractors and quality, with structured reporting so you always know the real status of your villa without being on site.
marbella.investment: Marbella combines strong capital appreciation with year-round rental demand at the luxury end. We support investors with build-to-sell and build-to-rent strategies, feasibility studies, and Golden Visa-eligible construction projects, working alongside our For Investors programme to maximise return per square metre.

faq.q: How much does it cost to build a villa in Marbella?
faq.a: Luxury villa construction in Marbella typically ranges from premium to ultra-premium per square metre depending on plot, finishes, pool and basement. We provide a detailed cost breakdown after reviewing your plot and brief.

faq.q: How long does it take to build a villa in Marbella?
faq.a: A turnkey villa usually takes 14–24 months including design and licensing. The building licence (licencia de obra mayor) and first occupation licence (LPO) are the main timeline drivers, and we plan around them from day one.

faq.q: Can foreign owners build in Marbella without living in Spain?
faq.a: Yes. Our project management service is designed for remote owners. We manage permits, contractors and quality control on your behalf and report on progress so you can build from abroad with full confidence.

faq.q: Do you handle building permits and licences in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes. Our administrative management team handles the full licensing process with Marbella town hall, including obra mayor, first occupation licence and energy certification.

faq.q: Which areas of Marbella do you build in?
faq.a: We work across the Golden Mile, Nueva Andalucía, Sierra Blanca, Marbella East and surrounding zones, as well as neighbouring Benahavís and Estepona.

benahavis.name: Benahavís
benahavis.heroTagline: Architecture, engineering and turnkey construction of exclusive villas in Benahavís, La Zagaleta and the hills above Marbella.
benahavis.overview:
Benahavís is the most active luxury new-build market on the Costa del Sol, home to La Zagaleta and some of the most exclusive gated communities in Europe. Its elevated plots offer privacy and panoramic sea views, but they also require advanced engineering and careful planning approval.

Structonix specialises in ground-up villa construction on these demanding hillside sites, combining architectural design with the structural expertise needed to build safely and beautifully on steep terrain.
benahavis.market: The Benahavís market is defined by large private plots, gated estates and ultra-high-net-worth buyers, particularly from the CIS, Northern Europe and the Middle East. Projects here are almost always bespoke new builds rather than renovations, with long-term value driven by exclusivity, privacy and build quality. Planning is managed through the Benahavís municipality, with strict requirements inside communities such as La Zagaleta.
benahavis.architecture: We design statement contemporary villas that respond to Benahavís's dramatic topography, maximising views while respecting estate design codes. Our architects work within the specific rules of gated communities and the local PGOU to secure approval without compromising the design.
benahavis.engineering: Steep hillside plots are the defining engineering challenge in Benahavís. We design deep foundations, retaining walls, terracing, infinity pools and multi-level basements engineered for the terrain, drainage and seismic considerations of the area.
benahavis.projectManagement: Building in a remote hillside estate requires tight logistics and coordination. We manage access, contractors, deliveries and quality control on complex sites, giving overseas owners a single point of accountability from groundwork to handover.
benahavis.investment: Benahavís delivers some of the strongest luxury appreciation on the Costa del Sol, with La Zagaleta among the most prestigious addresses in Spain. We help investors identify viable plots, run build feasibility and deliver villas positioned for premium resale or long-let luxury rental.

faq.q: Why build in Benahavís instead of Marbella?
faq.a: Benahavís offers larger plots, more privacy and panoramic views at a strong value, with La Zagaleta and other gated estates attracting ultra-high-net-worth buyers. It is ideal for bespoke new-build villas.

faq.q: Can you build in La Zagaleta?
faq.a: Yes. We build within gated estates including La Zagaleta, working to their specific design codes and approval processes while managing the full construction.

faq.q: Are hillside plots in Benahavís difficult to build on?
faq.a: They require specialist engineering for foundations, retaining and drainage, which is a core strength of our team. With the right structural design, hillside plots produce exceptional villas with unmatched views.

faq.q: How long does villa construction take in Benahavís?
faq.a: Bespoke hillside villas typically take 16–26 months including design, licensing and groundwork, which is more demanding than flat coastal plots.

faq.q: Do you handle permits in Benahavís?
faq.a: Yes. We manage the full licensing process through the Benahavís municipality and within gated-community requirements.

estepona.name: Estepona
estepona.heroTagline: Turnkey villa construction, architecture and development for the fastest-growing new-build market on the western Costa del Sol.
estepona.overview:
Estepona has become the fastest-growing new-build destination on the Costa del Sol, combining a regenerated old town, an expanding beachfront and strong demand for modern villas at better plot value than central Marbella. It is increasingly attractive to both end-users and developers.

Structonix delivers individual villas and small developments in Estepona, from the New Golden Mile to the hills behind the town, managing design, licensing and construction end to end.
estepona.market: Estepona offers more available land and lower plot prices than Marbella, making it a prime market for both custom villas and developer-led projects. The New Golden Mile corridor is especially active for contemporary villas and boutique developments. Strong infrastructure investment and rising demand make it one of the best risk-adjusted markets on the coast.
estepona.architecture: We design contemporary villas suited to Estepona's beachside and hillside plots, optimising sea views and indoor-outdoor living. Our architecture service covers everything from single villas to multi-unit residential schemes with planning approval through Estepona town hall.
estepona.engineering: From beachfront water-table conditions to elevated inland plots, we engineer foundations, structures, pools and building services appropriate to each site, fully compliant with Spanish and Andalusian regulations.
estepona.projectManagement: Whether a single villa or a small development, our project management keeps budget, programme and quality under control. For developers we provide structured cost and schedule reporting suitable for investors and finance partners.
estepona.investment: Estepona's combination of growth, value and rising demand makes it one of the strongest investment markets on the Costa del Sol. We support build-to-sell developments and build-to-rent villas with feasibility studies and end-to-end delivery designed around return on investment.

faq.q: Is Estepona a good place to build a villa?
faq.a: Yes. Estepona offers more available land and better plot value than Marbella while demand for modern villas keeps rising, especially along the New Golden Mile.

faq.q: How much does it cost to build a villa in Estepona?
faq.a: Construction costs are typically slightly lower than central Marbella due to plot value, though finish level is the main driver. We provide a detailed estimate after reviewing your plot and brief.

faq.q: Do you build developments as well as single villas in Estepona?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver both individual villas and small residential developments, with reporting suitable for developers and investors.

faq.q: Do you manage permits in Estepona?
faq.a: Yes. We handle the full licensing process through Estepona town hall, including building and first occupation licences.

faq.q: Is Estepona good for investment?
faq.a: Estepona offers one of the best risk-adjusted profiles on the coast, with strong growth, infrastructure investment and rising demand supporting both resale and rental returns.

costa-del-sol.name: Costa del Sol
costa-del-sol.h1: Luxury Construction & Development on the Costa del Sol
costa-del-sol.heroTagline: Architecture, engineering, construction and project management for luxury villas and developments across the Costa del Sol.
costa-del-sol.overviewTitle: Building on the Costa del Sol
costa-del-sol.overview:
The Costa del Sol is one of Europe's premier luxury property markets, stretching from Málaga through Marbella, Benahavís and Estepona to Sotogrande. It combines year-round climate, international demand and a mature construction industry serving high-net-worth owners and developers.

Structonix operates across the entire coast, delivering turnkey villas, renovations and developments. Our integrated team manages land, design, licensing and construction so international clients can build with a single trusted partner.
costa-del-sol.market: Across the Costa del Sol, the luxury segment is driven by international buyers seeking new-build quality, energy efficiency and modern design. Each municipality has its own planning rules and licence timelines, which makes local experience essential. From scarce premium plots in Marbella to growth markets in Estepona, we match strategy to each location.
costa-del-sol.architecture: We design contemporary and Mediterranean villas across the coast, tailored to each municipality's planning framework and each plot's orientation and views. Our architecture service runs from concept to fully approved technical documentation.
costa-del-sol.engineering: Coastal conditions, hillside terrain and high-specification villas all demand robust engineering. We deliver structural, MEP and pool engineering compliant with Spanish and Andalusian regulations across every part of the coast.
costa-del-sol.projectManagement: Our project management is built for international owners and developers building from abroad. We control budget, schedule, contractors and quality with transparent reporting, acting as your single point of accountability anywhere on the coast.
costa-del-sol.investment: The Costa del Sol offers durable capital appreciation and strong luxury rental demand. We support investors with feasibility studies, build-to-sell and build-to-rent strategies, and Golden Visa-eligible projects, coordinated through our For Investors programme.

faq.q: Which areas of the Costa del Sol does Structonix build in?
faq.a: We build across the entire coast, with a focus on Marbella, Benahavís, Estepona and the wider Málaga province, including Nueva Andalucía, the Golden Mile and Sotogrande.

faq.q: How much does it cost to build a villa on the Costa del Sol?
faq.a: Costs vary by location, plot and finish level. We provide a detailed, location-specific cost breakdown after reviewing your plot and requirements.

faq.q: Can I build on the Costa del Sol while living abroad?
faq.a: Yes. Our project management service is designed for international owners, managing permits, contractors and quality control on your behalf with regular reporting.

faq.q: Do you handle the full process from land to handover?
faq.a: Yes. We support clients from land due diligence and design through licensing, construction and first occupation, as a single integrated team.

faq.q: Is the Costa del Sol a good construction investment?
faq.a: Yes. The combination of international demand, year-round climate and limited premium supply supports strong appreciation and rental returns, particularly in the luxury segment.

construction-company-marbella.introTitle: A full-service construction company in Marbella
construction-company-marbella.intro:
Choosing the right construction company in Marbella is the single most important decision in any villa project. The market is demanding: scarce plots on the Golden Mile and in Nueva Andalucía, strict PGOU planning rules, hillside sites in Sierra Blanca, and discerning international owners who expect both design quality and absolute reliability.

Structonix is an integrated construction company that combines architecture, engineering and project management in a single team of more than 40 specialists. That means one contract, one point of accountability, and one team responsible for your villa from the first sketch to the handover of keys — exactly what owners building from abroad need.

villa-construction-marbella.introTitle: Turnkey luxury villa construction in Marbella
villa-construction-marbella.intro:
Building a villa in Marbella should be the most rewarding part of owning property on the Costa del Sol — not the most stressful. The reality is that bespoke villa construction here involves scarce premium plots, demanding hillside engineering in areas like Sierra Blanca and La Zagaleta, and a strict licensing process that can stall a project for months if handled badly.

Structonix delivers turnkey villa construction as a single integrated team of more than 40 architects, engineers and project managers. We take responsibility for the whole build, so your villa is delivered to the standard, budget and timeline agreed — with full visibility throughout.
